notes.title: Alpha Update 0.8.5 - Morphine syrette, methamphetamine
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,  It's been a few weeks since the last update since we're still mainly working on the new engine for the game. However, we're making good progress and are still aiming to release a first public build at the end of this month hopefully. 
For this update I added a morphine syrette that can be injected into worker NPCs to reduce pain and methamphetamine in an early form. You can get apatite ore by mining rocks and putting them into a jar or other type of item container - this will "crush" it into phosphorus. The ephedra shrub can be harvested by clicking on it with a container item (like a jar). To make methamphetamine you have to then add pseudoephedrine, ethanol (can be bought in shop) and phosphorus into a barrel and cook it over a heated oven. I haven't added any quests yet because I am still planning on changing some things for it in the new engine (like having the ephedra shrubs grow exclusively in a new Steppe biome, letting apatite ore only be crushed in a mortar and letting the player ferment ethanol in a keg from wheat. So this update is still a minor one but once the new engine is out we're going to start bringing out a lot more new mechanics, QoL improvements and content. I may also make a few preview posts in the coming weeks to show the systems that were modified in the new engine and what's more to come in the new few months.

notes.title: Final comment before Early Access release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The game is about to finally release into Early Access in a few minutes (we just gonna finish up on a few things). I wanted to write a small post before that to look back as well as give you guys info on what's planned going forward. 
The EA game now has more drugs, weapons & other chartered vehicle types to reach other parts of the world to smuggle to compared to the demo. In the last few weeks we wanted to focus on fixing as many bugs as possible so we also had to cut/simplify some newer drug production mechanics (but we're still going to add more depth to those soon). 
The price I've decided to set for the game at launch is about $15 (in US price, localized prices in other countries, and at 40% discount). I understand this might be a bit high for some individuals from poorer areas, however, I would like you to understand that the money is intended to go back into the development of the game, not to be profit for me.
The goal from today on is to gain funding to continue financing development (I don't earn any money myself & don't plan to which is fine since I am still in University but I need the money to continue hiring new & more talented developers than me, I already invested all my savings into the dev team, almost 10k USD).
Respectively, today should just be the start of the development of this game, for me it's only 5% complete compared to what I have planned for the game in the future, including so many great suggestions I've received from you guys like:
- Remaking the codebase for the game so that it's less prone to bugs and easier to add new features
- Character Customization
- Medical System (surgery, organ harvesting/transplant, torture)
- More Events
- Buying other physical vehicles (maybe even being able to build airstrips for planes to start)
- More interaction with other actors in the world (criminal organizations, politicians, law enforcement) whether it's alliances, rivalries, bribes, cartel raids etc.
- Multiplayer
- Mod support for things like items, clothing, events, etc.
- ... and a lot of other things the community already suggested

I also would like to thank everyone who has helped make this game possible since I released the very broken demo a little over a year ago. Everyone who has reported bugs, wishlist or develop the game.
Next update post will probably come within 24 hours after EA release, detailing how it went and what specifically is planned next. There's also definitely still going to be a few more bug fix updates during that period, to fix what new things are reported.

- Gigicom

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.7.0 - QoL, NPC rework, Graves
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This update adds a couple of new mechanics & replaced some the older ones. I've been hiring more developers recently so I can speed things up for release. Unfortunately, the Kickstarter did not work out as you may have seen but because the Steam Next Fest brought so many more wishlists than I expected, I now have a bit more security to invest the remainder of my own savings into the project.
The game is scheduled to release in May/June now, not April. I recently rescheduled the release date because we want to redo the Multiplayer & add delta-timing so it also works for people with low-end hardware. Until then, the demo will still stay up and get a few more updates.
With this release date postponing I also budgeted a bit more money for the development so we can add some more content than what I had initially planned for.

I am currently also looking for people to do social media marketing (Tiktok, YT Shorts, Instagram reels etc.) for the game. While I unfortunately don't have a budget for marketing yet, I am offering people who get someone to buy the game through a tracked affiliate link 75% of the net sale revenue *.
If you're interested, please send me a DM on Discord and I can send you an affiliate link. The goal of this is also to potentially find people who are good at creating social media content & interested in my game that I can hire once I do have a marketing budget in a few weeks.

I would also like to raise attention that we have a Google Spreadsheet file where you can help translate the game ( https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1m8M9Q5GqUe2RCJUueHavxAWe07zd1Qwgns52kr5nq6g/edit?usp=sharing ).
